name: cameri-skills
description: Monorepo of Claude Code plugins by Ricardo Arturo Cabral Mejía.

plugins.name: immune-system
plugins.description: Defensive security monitor for the agent instance — watches skills, plugins, and hooks for new or changed content, quarantines confirmed threats, alerts the operator, and removes only on confirmation.

plugins.name: ablate-ai-layer
plugins.description: Measure whether a repository's AI instructions still earn their place — runs the same real task with the layer intact and stripped, in throwaway git worktrees, then grades every rule against what actually changed.

plugins.name: actual-budget
plugins.description: Interact with your self-hosted Actual Budget instance — check balances, add transactions, and query budgets.

plugins.name: agent-resources
plugins.description: Build and audit Claude Code skills, hooks, MCP servers, and subagents — the toolkit for extending Claude Code itself.

plugins.name: anydoc
plugins.description: Convert Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF files to clean GitHub-Flavored Markdown via the anydoc CLI.

plugins.name: audiobookshelf
plugins.description: Interact with a self-hosted Audiobookshelf instance via its REST API — list libraries, browse and search library items, and check listening progress.

plugins.name: autoresearch
plugins.description: Autonomously optimize Claude Code skills using Karpathy's autoresearch methodology — binary evals, prompt mutation, and iterative improvement loops.

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: Workspace-wide knowledge graph backed by LatticeDB — syncs a graph-json snapshot in (defaulting to graphify's output), answers questions via Cypher, writes/links individual facts, soft- or permanently forgets a node/edge, and reports staleness/cost-to-re-study for any previously-learned path.

plugins.name: consider
plugins.description: Apply a proven decision-making or thinking-model framework — inversion, first-principles, second-order effects, Pareto, via negativa, opportunity cost, or Eisenhower prioritization — to a real decision or tradeoff moment.

plugins.name: container-management
plugins.description: Maintain Docker Compose services and custom images — update base images, pin sha256 digests, manage Containerfile/Dockerfile dependencies, test builds, and log all changes.

plugins.name: cronjobs
plugins.description: Schedule jobs using natural language — 'every 3 minutes', 'every weekday at 9am', 'once in 5 minutes'. Fires channel notifications when jobs are due.

plugins.name: doubt-driven-development
plugins.description: Adversarial fresh-context review of non-trivial in-flight decisions — CLAIM, EXTRACT, DOUBT, RECONCILE, STOP — with optional user-authorized cross-model escalation.

plugins.name: elevenlabs
plugins.description: Generate speech, transcribe audio, create music and sound effects, and build voice agents using the ElevenLabs API.

plugins.name: executable-skepticism
plugins.description: A verification protocol for evaluating theories, papers, models, or any confident quantitative claim by routing the verdict through executable, falsifiable tests instead of prose.

plugins.name: finance-manager
plugins.description: Reconcile bank statements from paperless-ngx against ActualBudget — syncs accounts, matches transactions, and self-improves reconciliation rules.

plugins.name: github-manager
plugins.description: Autonomous GitHub repository manager — handles webhook events for issues, PRs, discussions, CI failures, and security alerts across managed repos.

plugins.name: home-assistant
plugins.description: Interact with Home Assistant via the REST API — get entity states, call services, fire events, render Jinja2 templates, and query state history.

plugins.name: jj
plugins.description: Use Jujutsu (jj) instead of git for version control — core concepts plus actionable skills for the everyday operations git users reach for out of habit (commit, split, squash, cleanup, checkout, rebase).

plugins.name: journal
plugins.description: Keeps a series of narrative journals about what the user has been doing, written from Claude's own perspective by reading session history across every project on this machine plus the memory system.

plugins.name: knowledge-wiki
plugins.description: Maintains a self-updating, cross-linked markdown knowledge base — ingests durable facts and research as topic pages instead of re-deriving them each time, with query and link-consistency checks.

plugins.name: lightning
plugins.description: Bitcoin Lightning payment tools (parse/pay invoices, balances, transactions) via the official Alby MCP server over Nostr Wallet Connect.

plugins.name: nats
plugins.description: Connect Claude Code agents over NATS — message, ping, and discover other agents point-to-point.

plugins.name: netshoot
plugins.description: Network troubleshooting inside Docker container networks using nicolaka/netshoot.

plugins.name: nostr
plugins.description: Nostr channel for Claude Code — decentralized messaging over Nostr relays with DM pairing, allowlists, relay pool management, and NIP-04 encrypted DMs.

plugins.name: paperless
plugins.description: Upload documents to and search a Paperless-ngx instance via its REST API.

plugins.name: replicator
plugins.description: Grows and prunes this instance's own skill set via a nightly capture→meditate cycle with strict scrutiny and injection defense.

plugins.name: repo-hygiene-sweep
plugins.description: Sweep every standalone repo in a multi-repo workspace for uncommitted or unpushed work, without missing the ones a plain `git status`/`jj status` from the workspace root can't see.

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: Deliberately-invoked research skills — competitive analysis, deep-dive investigation, feasibility checks, landscape mapping, options comparison, and technical implementation research.

plugins.name: sandbox-manager
plugins.description: Manage the Claude Code sandbox itself — restart sessions, manage its own plugins/marketplaces, run post-restart health checks, and set up herdr for remote SSH attach.

plugins.name: simple-english
plugins.description: Write or rewrite technical text with the rules of ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English so it is clear, unambiguous, and free of AI slop.

plugins.name: technitium-dns
plugins.description: Manage Technitium DNS Server instances — configure, query stats, manage zones and records, and control DNS blocking with per-domain allow/block overrides and block list URLs.

plugins.name: telegram
plugins.description: Telegram channel for Claude Code — messaging bridge with built-in access control, pairing, and full Bot API coverage including voice note transcription.

plugins.name: telegram-ng
plugins.description: Telegram channel for Claude Code — messaging bridge with built-in access control. Fork of Anthropic's official telegram plugin for local development.

plugins.name: wallabag
plugins.description: Save, search, and manage read-it-later articles via your Wallabag instance.

plugins.name: webhooks
plugins.description: Receive webhook events from external systems (GitHub, Stripe, CI/CD, etc.) as channel notifications. Express listener with BullMQ processing, HMAC-SHA256 verification, IP allowlisting, and endpoint management.
